description_ru: Современный отдел. Аллювиальные отложения низкой пойменной террасы. Суглинки, супеси, илы, торф
note: GGK-200 O-43-XXVI (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, Ishim series, 1st edition; Novosibirsk TGU, I.P. Vasiliev, ed. S.B. Shatsky; approved VSEGEI/SNIIGGIMS 28.05.1963; printed VAGT Leningrad 1968; 73-74E 56d40m-57d20mN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 1935x2380 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); fills = map tints snap-sampled at labelled units (work/r200h/snap.py), calibrated on the map (drift cap 4 dE; terrace yellow-greens and eol?Q3 pinned); same-tint merges: alQ4(1)+alQ3II (high floodplain and 2nd terrace, two print tints), eolQ3-4+saQ3 (the eolian sands differ only by red dots); saQ3 (subaerial cover loams) and eol?Q3 coded E; frame = 4 measured corners + mid-side lines + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties (work/r200h/O-43-XXVI/ties_final.txt) ; legend units NOT classified (no separable map tint): d+klQ3-4: not found as a separable tint on the face / alQ2-3III: labelled once, no separable tint / saQ2: not found on the face / alQ2IV: not found on the face / Pg: tiny valley-side outcrops, not separable ; seed = map tint
